text: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
devotional: Read Psalm 34:4 slowly enough to hear the word freedom without rushing past it. A verse is wasted when it is only a slogan. It helps when it becomes a way of walking. text: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

text: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says the LORD.
devotional: Before the kitchen gets noisy, Isaiah 55:8 is enough for one honest minute. The word for today is Trust. You do not have to solve the whole day. Receive it again, simply, and let the board go quiet.

text: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

text: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

text: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
